description: Na₃ScBr₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P̅31c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form distorted NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent ScBr₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one ScBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-61°. There are three shorter (2.91 Å) and three longer (3.04 Å) Na-Br bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent ScBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-61°. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form ScBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. All Sc-Br bond lengths are 2.67 Å. Br is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Sc atom.
